hook.say: None of these five countries touches the ocean. Can you name every landlocked country from its outline?

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Switzerland has 4 national languages: German, French, Italian and Romansh.
questions.sayAnswer: Switzerland! It has 4 national languages: German, French, Italian and Romansh.

questions.fact: Afghanistan: its capital Kabul lies about 1,800 m above sea level.
questions.sayAnswer: Afghanistan! Its capital, Kabul, lies about 1800 meters above sea level.

questions.fact: Chad is named after Lake Chad, on its western edge.
questions.sayAnswer: Chad! It is named after Lake Chad, on its western edge.

questions.fact: Paraguay is one of only two landlocked countries in South America.
questions.sayAnswer: Paraguay! It is one of only 2 landlocked countries in South America.

questions.fact: Uzbekistan is doubly landlocked: all its neighbours are landlocked too.
questions.sayAnswer: Uzbekistan! It is doubly landlocked: all of its neighbours are landlocked too.
